row:
Hi Viewers!
 
Thanks for stopping by my YouTube channel. I'm a Remedial Massage Therapist and Reiki energy healer based in Melton West. The content on my page consists of some simple and effective self massage techniques that you can do in the comfort of your own home during this isolation stage. 

It will also include some other handy tips to help enhance your health and well-being in mind, body and spirit!

If you would like some more information on my background as a practitioner, or would like to shop online for some of my handmade aromatherapy products to sustain your wellness, please visit my website at www.capironsbotanicals.com

Namaste!
